prepared_remarks: Tim Cook: Good afternoon, everyone. We're pleased to report our fourth fiscal quarter results, capping a challenging but resilient year. Revenue for Q4 was $89.5 billion, down 1% year-over-year. Services achieved a new all-time revenue record of $22.3 billion, up 16%. We returned over $25 billion to shareholders during the quarter through dividends and buybacks.
forward_guidance: For Q1 FY2024, we expect revenue similar to Q1 FY2023. We expect Services to continue growing at double-digit rates. We expect gross margin between 45% and 46%.

prepared_remarks: Satya Nadella: Our strong start to fiscal 2024 reflects continued demand for AI solutions. Revenue was $56.5 billion, up 13% year-over-year. Azure grew 29%, accelerating from prior quarter. Copilot integrations are showing strong early adoption across enterprise customers.
forward_guidance: For Q2 FY2024, we expect revenue of $60.4-61.4 billion. Intelligent Cloud revenue expected at $25.1-25.4 billion. Azure growth expected to accelerate by 1-2 points.
